js_fields.description:
Ishtirokchisi xizmatlarning to‘liq hajmini bajarish uchun zarur bo‘lgan har bir ko‘rsatilgan turdagi putur yetkazmasdan nazorat qilish (BN) va texnik diagnostika uskunalarining to‘liq to‘plamiga egalik qilishi yoki ulardan foydalanish uchun qonuniy huquqqa ega bo‘lishi shart. Bunga LRUT, UT/PAUT, UTT, VT, MT/PT usullari bo‘yicha nazorat qilish, uchqunli nazorat, katod himoyasi (KH) parametrlarini o‘lchash uskunalari hamda xizmatlarning to‘liq hajmini bajarish uchun zarur bo‘lgan boshqa uskunalar kiradi.
Ishtirokchisi uskunalarga egalik huquqini yoki ulardan foydalanish bo‘yicha qonuniy huquqlarini tasdiqlovchi tegishli hujjatlarni, jumladan, ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazilganlik to‘g‘risidagi guvohnomalar, inventarizatsiya qaydnomalari, buxgalteriya hisobotlari, ijara shartnomalari, uskunalardan foydalanish to‘g‘risidagi shartnomalar yoki boshqa teng kuchga ega tasdiqlovchi hujjatlarni taqdim etishi shart.
Ijaraga olingan yoki uchinchi shaxslarga tegishli uskunalardan foydalanilgan taqdirda, tender ishtirokchisi mazkur uskunalardan loyihani amalga oshirishning butun muddati davomida foydalanish imkoniyati mavjud bo‘lishini tasdiqlashi shart.
 /
The Bidder shall own or have the legal right to use a complete set of non-destructive testing (NDT) and technical diagnostic equipment of each specified type required to perform the full scope of services, including equipment for LRUT, UT/PAUT, UTT, VT, MT/PT, spark testing, cathodic protection (CP) measurements, and other equipment necessary to perform the full scope of services.
The Bidder shall provide relevant documentary evidence of ownership or legal rights to use the equipment, such as registration certificates, inventory records, accounting statements, lease agreements, equipment use agreements, or other equivalent supporting documents.
In the case of leased or third-party equipment, the Bidder shall demonstrate that the equipment will be available for use throughout the entire project execution period.

Agar uskunalar Ishtirokchining mulki hisoblanmasa, mazkur loyiha doirasida ushbu uskunalardan foydalanish imkoniyati mavjudligini tasdiqlovchi tegishli shartnomalar yoki boshqa tasdiqlovchi hujjatlar taqdim etilishi shart./

js_fields.description:
Ishtirokchisi mazkur loyiha uchun taklif etilayotgan putur yetkazmasdan nazorat qilish (BN) ma’lumotlarini qayta ishlash va tahlil qilishga mo‘ljallangan maxsus dasturiy ta’minotning batafsil tavsifini taqdim etishi shart. Dasturiy ta’minot quyidagi talablarga javob berishi kerak:
1. LRUT, UT/PAUT va UTT kabi turli xil BN usullari yordamida olingan ma’lumotlarni qayta ishlash imkoniyatini ta’minlashi.
2. Xavf-xatarlarga asoslangan nazorat (RBI) bo‘yicha kengaytirilgan tahlil qilish imkoniyatlariga ega bo‘lishi.
3. Aniqlangan nuqsonlarni baholangan xavf darajalariga muvofiq avtomatik ravishda tasniflash, saralash va ustuvorlik darajasi bo‘yicha tartiblash imkoniyatini ta’minlashi.
4. Ma’lumotlarni Buyurtmachining mavjud GIS tizimi va ma’lumotlar bazalari bilan integratsiya qilishni osonlashtirish maqsadida nazorat va tahlil natijalarini MS Excel formatida eksport qilish imkoniyatini qo‘llab-quvvatlashi.
5. Ishtirokchisi yetkazib beriladigan dasturiy ta’minot ingliz yoki rus tillarini qo‘llab-quvvatlashini hamda muddatsiz litsenziya asosida taqdim etilishini ta’minlash majburiyatini oladi. /
Участник должен предоставить подробное описание специализированного программного обеспечения для обработки и анализа данных неразрушающего контроля (НК), предлагаемого для данного проекта. Программное обеспечение должно соответствовать следующим требованиям:
1. Обеспечивать обработку данных, полученных с помощью различных методов НК, включая LRUT, UT/PAUT и UTT.
2. Иметь расширенные возможности анализа на основе риск-ориентированного контроля (RBI).
3. Обеспечивать возможность автоматической классификации, сортировки и ранжирования обнаруженных дефектов в соответствии с оцененными уровнями риска.
4. Поддерживать экспорт результатов контроля и анализа в формате MS Excel для облегчения интеграции данных с существующей ГИС-системой и базами данных Заказчика.
5. Участник обязуется обеспечить, чтобы поставляемое программное обеспечение поддерживало английский или русский языки и предоставлялось на условиях бессрочной лицензии.

The Bidder shall provide a detailed description of the specialized non-destructive testing (NDT) data processing and analysis software proposed for this Project. The software shall meet the following requirements:
1. Support the processing of data obtained from various NDT methods, including LRUT, UT/PAUT, and UTT.
2. Have advanced Risk-Based Inspection (RBI) analysis capabilities.
3. Be capable of automatically classifying, sorting, and ranking detected defects according to their assessed risk levels.
4. Support the export of inspection and analysis results in MS Excel format to facilitate data integration with the Owner's existing GIS system and databases.
5. The Bidder shall undertake that the software to be delivered shall support English or Russian and shall be provided under a perpetual license.
